turns.prompt: Inventory 12 m of 10-mm teal ribbon in drawer C and one pair of scissors on shelf T. Reserve 4 m of ribbon for costumes. A banner needs 9 m and ribbon is sold in 3 m rolls. Can the banner start with what is free? Show the ledger and shortage.
expectations: Shows 12 m on hand, 4 m reserved for costumes and 8 m free.
Identifies a 1 m shortage for the banner and one 3 m roll if a purchase is needed.
Keeps the scissors as one reusable tool on shelf T.
Leaves the actual ribbon balance at 12 m without assuming a purchase or consuming the reservation.

turns.prompt: Costumes used 3 m from their reservation and released the spare metre. The scissors are on loan at the costume table. Update the banner decision. For a finished seasonal decoration, which three maintenance outcomes does the decor specialist log according to the suite guide? Name your source.
expectations: Shows 9 m on hand, zero reserved and 9 m available after the 3 m use and 1 m release.
Shows the 9 m banner now fits available stock without ordering another roll or deducting the planned banner yet.
Shows one pair of scissors on loan at the costume table without consuming it.
Identifies repaired, cleaned and retired as the maintenance outcomes, and identifies the supporting file actually used.
